rules.label: Free care at or below 100% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is at or below 100% of the FPL are eligible to receive free care.

rules.label: Up to 80% discount for 100%-125% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 100% and below 125% of the FPL would be eligible for up to an 80% discount.

rules.label: Up to 60% discount for 125%-150% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 125% and below 150% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 60% discount.

rules.label: Up to 40% discount for 150%-200% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 150% and below 200% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 40% discount.

rules.label: Up to 20% discount for 200%-250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 200% and below 250% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 20% discount.

rules.label: Case-by-case consideration above 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income exceeds 250% of the FPL will generally not be deemed eligible for financial assistance; but, may be considered for financial assistance on a case-by-case basis based on their specific circumstances, such as catastrophic illness or medical indigence, at the discretion of RGH.

rules.label: Uninsured or underinsured
rules.quote: You may be able to obtain financial assistance if you are uninsured, underinsured.

notes: The policy excludes certain non-employed providers such as Radiologists from Colorado Imaging Associates and Specialists from San Luis Valley Health, ENT, OB, etc.
The policy states that no extraordinary collection action will be taken before 182 days from the first bill for self-pay accounts.

The policy indicates that RGH will refrain from initiating Extraordinary Collection Actions (ECA) for Emergency Care provided by RGH, including Emergency and Inpatient care and all attached emergency care including ancillary services.

The policy mentions that the determination of financial need may be done at any point in the collection cycle and that need for financial assistance shall be re-evaluated every 12 months or if financial situation changes.
The policy includes a sliding fee scale with specific dollar amounts for different FPL ranges in addition to percentage discounts.
